# Spicy Chat AI

> Independent research on Spicy Chat AI character roleplay, models, context, personas, memory, current plan differences, safety rules, and alternatives.

Canonical publication: https://spicychatai.fun/

This is an independent editorial publication, not the official provider. Articles distinguish published provider information from suggested evaluation methods. Examples and proposed tests are not measured benchmark results. Check dated sources and live provider terms for changing features and prices.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://spicychatai.fun/): Overview and practical decision guidance.
- [Blog and comparisons](https://spicychatai.fun/blog/): Browse the editorial article collection.
